title: Run takeover
summary: Successor creation evaluates the older run through complete frozen QA selections. An incomplete historical selection refuses with reviewed operator repair recovery before resumption. Original source and target identities remain authoritative. A containing successor on the same flow and target takes over waiting members under existing QA and approval rules. The takeover settles the old run in the same transaction. Without shared QA or approval, a member stays in the old run only when the old run already closed it; every unclosed member, including a passed-but-open, refused or non-final one, moves. The old run then reads succeeded when it delivered at least one member and cancelled when none stayed, so it never sits executing without a driver; a refused succeeded gate refuses the takeover with takeover_settlement_refused. With shared QA or approval every unclosed member moves and the old run is cancelled, so no approval is skipped. While a live steering seat covers the project only the seat holder or the older run's creating session may take it over, live driver or not; other sessions are refused with takeover_reserved_for_steering and report the landing to steering. start-for-item creates, takes over, enrolls and validates in one transaction, so any refusal writes nothing and an item the takeover moved is enrolled once. Creation refuses up front when the caller's machine could not drive a self-deploy run. A takeover that aborts no running QA execution sends the owner no notice. When it aborts one, the waking notice names the new run and says to keep the claim and stay parked.
